peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (37.4): 2.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 147 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Context, not scored: resales in 16.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Orchard MRT about 450 m, Newton MRT about 930 m; closer than 243 of 551 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Junior) about 1,150 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 160 m), more than 462 of 551 similar developments (the same as 53); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 1,060 m; nearest park Sbg Lc Zone 1 (Tnc) about 1,300 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 540 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 770 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 970 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 1,030 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,220 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,370 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,480 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,550 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 433 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 667 new sales and 1,226 resales (1,893 purchases); new sales were 35.2% of these purchases. Subsales (32) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 770 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 890 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,800 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,226 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 471 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,226 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,335 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−8.2%). Planning-area private resales +16%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
